_meta.description: Audience-adaptive density presets. Set 'audience' in deck YAML to activate.

c-suite.label: C-Suite / Executive
c-suite.headline_guidance: Headlines should be decisions or recommendations, not topics. 'We should invest $2M' not 'Budget Overview'.
c-suite.notes: Lead with the answer. One idea per slide. Evidence in appendix.

manager.label: Manager / Director
manager.headline_guidance: Headlines should state what's happening and when. 'Migration partner onboards April 15' not 'Partner Update'.
manager.notes: Show who-does-what-by-when. Include enough detail for operational decisions.

ic.label: IC / Engineer
ic.headline_guidance: Headlines should describe the content precisely. 'VM migration path by hypervisor type and target compute service'.
ic.notes: Provide technical truth. Tables and diagrams preferred over narrative.
